preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s consists only of lowercase English letters.
The integers n (length of s) and p (alphabet limit) are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(ord(c) - ord('a') < p for c in s)
preconditions.description: Every character in s is among the first p letters of the English alphabet.

preconditions.expression: not any(s[i] == s[i+1] for i in range(len(s)-1)) and not any(s[i] == s[i+2] and s[i+1] == s[i+2] for i in range(len(s)-2))
preconditions.description: The string s contains no palindrome contiguous substring of length 2 or more (no adjacent or length-3 palindromes).

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (len(stdout) == n and all(ord(c) - ord('a') < p for c in stdout) and not any(stdout[i] == stdout[i+1] for i in range(n-1)) and not any(stdout[i] == stdout[i+2] and stdout[i+1] == stdout[i+2] for i in range(n-2)))
postconditions.description: If stdout is not 'NO', it is a tolerable string of length n with characters from the first p letters, containing no palindrome contiguous substring of length 2 or more.

postconditions.expression: stdout != 'NO' and (s < stdout and all(s[:i] == stdout[:i] and s[i] < stdout[i] for i in range(n)))
postconditions.description: If stdout is not 'NO', it is the lexicographically next tolerable string after s (i.e., the smallest tolerable string greater than s).

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (stdout != 'NO' and not any(s > candidate and all(candidate[:i] == s[:i] and candidate[i] < s[i] for i in range(n)) for candidate in [t for t in generate_tolerable(n, p) if t > s]))
postconditions.description: If stdout is not 'NO', there is no tolerable string lexicographically between s and stdout. If stdout is 'NO', no such tolerable string exists.
